query: Planning a Christmas and New Year trip to Goa with my partner, roughly 28th December to 2nd January. We've both been to Goa before so we're interested in the typical touristy beach hopping as well as more keen on exploring the Portuguese heritage churches in Old Goa, doing a spice plantation tour, and finding some good feni and local Goan food spots. We'd love to catch some live music on New Year's Eve but nothing too chaotic. Looking at staying in North Goa, somewhere between Panjim and Candolim area. If there are any good sunrise spots or lesser known beaches worth a morning visit, that'd be great.
query_summary: Savor the vibrant Goan sunrise, indulge in feni, feast on local delicacies, and serenade the New Year in the tranquil backdrop of North Goa's historic charm.
